environment.assumption: day period = lights-on period (14 h); night = lights-off (10 h); setpoints, not logged values

derived.tbase_note: T_base 5.7 C = Butturini diaf024 organ beta-growth base; reuse is an assumption

lights_off_dehumidification.note: holding RH 60 % through the 26->22 C drop requires removing water; log RH at lights-off to confirm the setpoint is actually held

derived.DLI_rule: DLI [mol m-2 d-1] = PPFD_mean [umol m-2 s-1] x 14 h x 0.0036 = 0.0504 x PPFD_mean; PPFD_mean from the PPFD meter only

light_ratio_map.source: PAR Collector (iPhone app) screenshot, clock 10:37 (date assumed 2026-10-10 - confirm)
light_ratio_map.status: uncalibrated phone app - values are used ONLY as ratios (user decision 2026-10-10: 광분포는 비율로만 적용)

grid.app_grid: 6x6 with only the top-left 4x4 filled; zeros are UNMEASURED cells, not dark - excluded
grid.orientation: row 1 = top row of the app screen, col 1 = leftmost app column (screen order, not shelf order); physical mapping: see layout

light_ratio_map.ratio_definition: r = value / mean(16 measured cells) (canonical; mean = 1.00). ratio_to_max kept for reference only.
light_ratio_map.application_rule: PPFD(plant) = PPFD_ref x r(position). r at a plant = its cell value, or bilinear interpolation between cell centres when the plant sits between cells; outside the measured 4x4 hull use the nearest cell and flag extrapolated=true. PPFD_ref comes from the calibrated PPFD meter (or the light model's own normalisation) - never from the app's absolute values.

uses.light_model_validation: normalise model-predicted PPFD at the same 16 points by their mean; compare with r (report ratio RMSE and Pearson r) - shape check without absolute calibration
uses.density_experiment_covariate: pots are never moved, so each plant's r is a fixed covariate - join plant IDs to slot_id in plant_slot_light_ratio_20261010.csv

light_ratio_map.planned_check_when_meter_arrives: re-measure r1c2 (max), r4c4 (min), r2c2 and r1c1 at the same height with the PPFD meter; if any meter ratio differs from the app ratio by > 0.05 (proposed threshold), re-map the grid with the meter
known_limits: phone sensors have poor cosine response: oblique-light cells (edges) may read low, exaggerating the gradient
a single snapshot; lamp warm-up, height and plant shading at measurement time are unrecorded
the other-variety plants are taller and stand in the front row: they may shade the front dwarf row and sit closer to the lamp than the measurement height; neither is in the app grid

layout.source_kind: user_stated (2026-10-10) + user photos 2026-10-10 (3 top-down, 1 oblique overview, 1 cropped photo)
layout.trays: 3 trays only (user correction 2026-10-10: '트레이는 3개'), each 6 dwarf '앉은뱅이' + 2 other-variety plants = 24 plants. Grid column 4 is NOT a tray (user: '따로 1개').

tray_internal_layout.status: confirmed from the 3 top-down photos (all three trays)
tray_internal_layout.dwarf: 2 pots wide x 3 rows deep (6 pots) - the three rows nearest the back wall
tray_internal_layout.other_variety: 2 tall pots in the front row, directly in front of the dwarf rows (light green, fruiting)
tray_internal_layout.tray_axis: long axis runs front-back: 2 pots wide x 4 pot rows deep including the other-variety row

layout.grid_fit: 1 grid column = 1 tray width (2 pots); 1 grid row ~ 1 pot row (4 rows = 3 dwarf rows + 1 other-variety row). Assumes the user's evenly spaced grid lines up with the pot rows (user: grid taken irrespective of trays, the 3 trays lie inside the 4x4 area).
layout.within_row_resolution: the left and right pot of a row share one grid cell; no left/right difference is resolvable
layout.rows: grid row 1 = back (wall side), row 4 = front (user_stated 2026-10-10: '벽'). Pot row k from the wall = grid row k; row 4 = other-variety front row

column_physical_order.status: user_confirmed 2026-10-10 (user agreed with the photo reading: col4 at the left end)
column_physical_order.photo_reading: the right end of the tray row is the shelf post with nothing beyond it (top-down photo 3), so the extra grid column 4 ('따로 1개') must lie at the LEFT end, where the overview photo shows tall white pots with dwarf plants behind the glass. Hence col1 = right-end tray by the post, col2 = middle tray, col3 = left tray (leggy plants with adventitious roots on the stems), col4 = left end, outside the trays.
column_physical_order.superseded: 'left -> right seen from the front' in the first version was Claude's assumption, never user-stated
column_physical_order.robust_under_either_order: tray2 is the middle tray (mean 1.124); only the physical identities of tray1 and tray3 swap

layout.col4_contents: user: '따로 1개' (one separate item), not a tray. Photos show tall white pots with dwarf plants at the left end; what '1개' refers to is unrecorded.

tray_area_base.note: r is normalised by the 16-cell mean (incl. column 4, outside the trays). If PPFD_ref is measured as the mean over the 3 trays (cols 1-3) instead, divide r by this value so the trays average 1.00.

per_plant_rule_now.replaces: v1 (2026-10-10): tray mean with the tray range as uncertainty - written before the in-tray layout was confirmed
per_plant_rule_now.rule: slot ratio = the grid cell of its tray column and pot row (row 1 = wall). v2 interim (before the row direction was known): each slot had two candidates (row 1 = back, row 1 = front); ratio_now = their mean, bounds = the two candidates. Pot rows 2-3 swap grid rows 2<->3 and stay close; pot row 1 (back dwarf) and row 4 (other variety) swap grid rows 1<->4.
per_plant_rule_now.row_direction: resolved 2026-10-10: row 1 = wall side. ratio_now = ratio_if_row1_back (lo = hi = same); the row1_front column is kept only for traceability
